svg.aria-label: SPWM signal chain: two AD9833 waveform generators feed an LM311 comparator, a gate driver with dead time drives an H-bridge on the DC bus, and an LC filter delivers the sine to the load
svg.text: From two small waveforms to a 230 V sine: the SPWM chain

text.tspan: Signal chain — sine and triangle compared, the result switches the bridge, the LC filter averages
